subject: Evergreen Bank - Security deliverables & MAP timeline (post-demo recap)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.com>
To: Alex Liu <alex.liu@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.ca@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: security checklist & proposed MAP milestones

Alex / Priya — thanks for today's demo and the walkthrough. Quick recap and next steps as we discussed, plus a first-pass MAP excerpt focused on the security/SOC 2 milestone so we can align owners and dates.

Key takeaways from the call:
- Evergreen will run an internal security review and needs a consolidated evidence package from Redwood (questionnaire answers + artifacts).
- Target business close remains dependent on receiving the SOC 2 evidence and completing control demos for GA access flows.
- Legal indicated they will need the initial MAP (milestones + owners) to start procurement intake.

Proposed MAP snippet (security milestone):
1) Redwood completes SOC 2 questionnaire answers (draft) — owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) — proposed due: 2026-11-12
2) Evidence upload (logs, diagrams, config snapshots) to secure drive — owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) — proposed due: 2026-11-19
3) Control demo (SRE + product) — scheduled week of 2026-11-29 (mutually agreed slot) — owners: Ben / Alex
4) Legal & procurement review — owner: Evergreen legal — start: 2026-12-01
5) Final package delivery (SOC 2 bundle) — owner: Redwood delivery — target handoff: 2026-12-10
6) Target close (contract execution + provisioning) — tentative: 2026-12-15

Dependencies:
- Evergreen provides list of in-scope teams and any custom evidence requirements (encryption KMS provenance, vendor attestations).
- Redwood SRE to run an export of 90-day access logs and configuration snapshots.

Attachments: "evergreen-map-draft-v1.pdf" (MAP draft), "redwood-soc2-evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx" (initial evidence checklist).

Ask: please confirm (1) owners above, (2) viability of proposed dates, and (3) any additional artifacts Evergreen requires. If any of these dates are tight we can slide the final handoff + close by up to one week — call that out so I can update the MAP.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.ch@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Alex Liu <alex.liu@evergreenbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <p.desai@evergreenbank.com>, legal@evergreenbank.com
Date: 2026-11-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security checklist & proposed MAP milestones

Thanks, Irene — good summary. A couple notes from our side:
- We have an internal audit freeze the week of 2026-12-13 which pushes our procurement calendar. Can we move the "target close" to 2026-12-22 instead of Dec 15? That gives legal and procurement time after our freeze window.
- For evidence, we need an explicit list of the artifact file types you will provide (e.g., access logs as CSV, network diagram PDF, config snapshots as tar.gz) and confirmation on retention windows for logs.
- We also need to know whether Redwood can provide KMS key provenance (audit entries) for encrypted artifact storage — that’s a blocker for one of our compliance reviewers.

If you can update the MAP with the artifact formats and call out KMS provenance as "required / optional" that will help us triage.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Liu
Director, Cloud Security | Evergreen Bank
alex.liu@evergreenbank.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.com>
To: Alex Liu <alex.liu@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.ca@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Updated MAP + evidence format notes (Evergreen)

Alex / Priya / team — updated below to reflect your audit window and the evidence formats you called out. I'm making Marissa the primary for questionnaire answers and Ben the primary for infra evidence so we have clear handoffs.

Updated MAP — security milestone (chronological):
A) Questionnaire draft (initial answers)
   - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole
   - Deliverable: completed questionnaire (PDF + editable XLSX)
   - Due: 2026-11-12
   - Dependencies: Evergreen to share any custom control mappings (e.g., additional data residency Qs) by 2026-11-05

B) Evidence export & upload
   - Owner (Redwood): Ben Carter
   - Deliverables & formats:
     * Access logs (90-day) — CSV gzip (logs_YYYYMMDD.csv.gz)
     * Audit trail exports (user provisioning events) — JSONL compressed
     * Network diagrams — PDF (v1.0) + source Visio/Drawio if requested
     * Config snapshots (service configs) — tar.gz with manifest.txt
     * KMS provenance logs — redacted audit entries (PDF + CSV) — NOTE: KMS provider agreement may require a separate request; list as "available upon request"
     * Pen test summary — PDF (if available)
   - Due: 2026-11-19
   - Storage: secure drive link (we will share access-controlled Drive folder).

C) Control demo (SRE + product deep-dive)
   - Owners: Ben Carter (Redwood) / Alex Liu (Evergreen)
   - Format: 30–45 minute screenshare with runbook walkthrough and live log export
   - Window: week of 2026-11-29 — propose 2026-11-30 10:00 PST; please confirm

D) Legal & procurement intake
   - Owner: Evergreen legal
   - Start: 2026-12-01

E) Final security package delivery (hand-off to Evergreen legal + compliance)
   - Owner: Marissa + Delivery team (Redwood)
   - Deliverables: consolidated ZIP of questionnaire, artifacts, demo recordings, manifest (JSON manifest file listing filenames and sha256 sums)
   - Target handoff: 2026-12-10 (we can move this to 2026-12-17 if you need the extra week)

F) Target close (contract + provisioning)
   - Tentative: 2026-12-22 (per Alex request)

Notes / dependencies / blockers:
- KMS provenance: we can provide redacted audit exports; full provider-level audit entries may require a formal request to our cloud provider and MD (timeboxed). Marking as "available upon request" in the MAP to avoid blocking the earlier dates.
- Vendor attestations: Evergreen to confirm which third-party vendor statements they require (we can pull vendor attestations and attach).
- Evidence volume: some exports (logs, configs) may be large; Ben will coordinate a secure S3 share or Drive transfer with pre-signed URLs.

Attachments included: "evergreen-map-draft-v1.pdf", "redwood-soc2-evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx". HubSpot deal link and Drive folder are below.

Action items for Redwood:
- Marissa: finalize questionnaire answers (due 11/12)
- Ben: prepare log exports + manifest (due 11/19)
- Irene: coordinate demo scheduling and update MAP in HubSpot (ongoing)

Action items for Evergreen:
- Alex / Priya: confirm demo slot week of 11/29 and confirm vendor attestations list by 11/05
- Legal: confirm procurement intake date (target 12/01)

If that aligns I will update the HubSpot MAP and attach the deliverables checklist.

Best,
Irene
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Liu <alex.liu@evergreenbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <p.desai@evergreenbank.com>, legal@evergreenbank.com
Date: 2026-11-04T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + evidence format notes (Evergreen)

Thanks — this looks great and addresses our asks. Confirming:
- New target close 2026-12-22 (we'll plan procurement around that)
- Priya will own vendor attestations and will send the vendor list by 2026-11-05
- Demo slot: 2026-11-30 10:00 PST works for our team

We appreciate the clear owners and formats. I'll watch for the Drive link and HubSpot update.

—Alex
Director, Cloud Security | Evergreen Bank
